tasks.title: Draft PO for 50 t of oaten hay for Bowmans
Confirm Bowmans capacity and QC release for the 450 t order
Confirm carrier booking and 15 December ETA for Saigon Dairy Co.
Check the 50 t purchase commitment against budget

final:
G-001 has a **50 t oaten hay shortfall** for Saigon Dairy Co.’s 450 t order.  
Procurement will draft a PO for 50 t for receipt at Bowmans by 5 December.  
Production will confirm site capacity and QC release by 5 December, after Procurement completes its task.  
By 27 November, Sales Fulfilment will confirm the carrier booking and 15 December ETA, and Finance will check the purchase against budget.  
The submitted plan is **awaiting CEO approval**.
